LanguageData.Gun_Howa_Type_64_RWP.label: Howa Type 64
LanguageData.Gun_Howa_Type_64_RWP.description: The Howa Type 64 is a Japanese-designed battle rifle known for its reliability and accuracy. Chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO, it delivers powerful, medium-range fire with moderate recoil. Though less advanced than newer models, its well-balanced design makes it a favored choice for those seeking a rugged and dependable weapon in the field.
